reviews.decision: Retain the fixed 40h DOSX selector adaptation using original descriptor-cache helpers. Historical FSTI trace confirms the original generic lookup cannot resolve it in the selected context. An owner-side publication would require a proven transition boundary and separate review.
Retain SS.B as address width for the restored outer stack pointer. Original mixed-width control gives the wrong SP/ESP while preserving the independent operand width for the return frame.

Remove two nonoriginal blanks before existing anchors. Keep WOW environment sizing and projection before copying into the guest environment block, the host-sized current-directory temporary, and bounded SAS copy-back from the known staged path. Original flat aliases can fail across noncontiguous guest mapping.

Preserve COPYDATA ownership, same-operation DDE unwind, and success publication on the completed conversion. Exact original/current focused controls and actual consumers justify the dispatch and cleanup boundary.

Retain original priority/list/event policy fed by explicit process shared state and the current native-thread owner. The native parked-stack readiness check prevents waking a task without a resumable stack. The original private global kernel state is unavailable here.

Keep original DOSX table publication extended to the CCPU GDT/LDT backing, distinct from native process LDT. Verified actual CVIDC setter bindings and lifetime of the shared-pool allocations; historical proof does not establish every low-memory transition.

Shorten the package-path provenance comment, retaining the divergence ID and original logical call line 209. The approved explicit firmware header stays: the original host Windows COMMAND path is absent, while the package COMMAND path exists.

Keep native focus callback scope and original navigation. An actual retired-child probe shows the original rescan can loop. Original count exhaustion can fall out of the nonvoid function for a dialog with 513 disabled matching controls; retain explicit NULL.
Original > accepts the array length as a valid scan-code index for both byte tables. Keep >= for the actual one-past boundary. Original valid scan code mapping remains unchanged.

Retain finite headers and omit the private native gpsi and RESCALLS provider table. Actual original compile hits unavailable private bindings; the selected guest shared-info address is independently owned and existing resource callbacks register once.

verification: Pinned sources and hashes, masked census, and unchanged selected executable lines and directives checked.
